notes: DDR3 SDRAM exposes four Mode Registers (MR0, MR1, MR2, MR3) plus one Multi-Purpose Register (MPR) accessed indirectly via MR3 enable. There is no memory-mapped offset; each register is selected by BA[1:0] during a Mode Register Set (MRS) command (CS#=L, RAS#=L, CAS#=L, WE#=L). All MRS commands must be issued with all banks precharged and tRP satisfied; tMRD (≥ 4 nCK) and tMOD (≥ max(12 nCK, 15 ns)) must be honoured between successive MRS commands and from MRS to a non-MRS command.

registers.name: MR0
registers.long_name: Mode Register 0 — Burst Length / Read Burst Type / CAS Latency / DLL Reset / Write Recovery / Precharge PD DLL
registers.access: Write via MRS with BA[1:0] = 00. Read-back is not supported (write-only architectural register).

fields.name: BL
fields.description: Burst Length: 00 = BL8 fixed, 01 = BC4 or BL8 on-the-fly (A12/BC# during RD/WR), 10 = BC4 fixed, 11 = Reserved.

fields.name: CL bit0
fields.description: Low-order bit of CAS Latency (combined with A[6:4]).

fields.name: RBT
fields.description: Read Burst Type: 0 = Nibble Sequential, 1 = Interleave.

fields.name: CL bits[3:1]
fields.description: High-order bits of CAS Latency. Combined with A2: {A6,A5,A4,A2} = 0010 → CL=5, 0100 → CL=6, 0110 → CL=7, 1000 → CL=8, 1010 → CL=9, 1100 → CL=10, 1110 → CL=11 (DDR3-1600 optional).

fields.name: TM
fields.description: Test Mode: 0 = Normal Operation, 1 = Test Mode (vendor-reserved, must not be used).

fields.name: DLL Reset
fields.description: 0 = No DLL reset, 1 = Reset DLL (self-clearing; required after MR1 DLL enable and certain frequency changes).

fields.name: WR (Write Recovery for AutoPrecharge)
fields.description: Encoded number of cycles for auto-precharge write recovery: 001 = 5, 010 = 6, 011 = 7, 100 = 8, 101 = 10, 110 = 12, 000/111 = Reserved. WR[cycles] = roundup(tWR[ns] / tCK[ns]).

fields.name: PPD
fields.description: Precharge Power-Down DLL: 0 = Slow Exit (DLL off in PD), 1 = Fast Exit (DLL on in PD).

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved for Future Use. Must be programmed to 0.

registers.name: MR1
registers.long_name: Mode Register 1 — DLL Enable / Output Driver Impedance / Rtt_Nom / Additive Latency / Write Leveling / TDQS / Qoff

fields.name: DLL
fields.description: DLL Enable: 0 = Enable (normal), 1 = Disable (DLL-off mode; only CL=6, CWL=6).

fields.name: D.I.C bit0
fields.description: Output Driver Impedance Control low-order bit (combined with A5).

fields.name: Rtt_Nom bit0
fields.description: Low-order bit of Rtt_Nom on-die termination (combined with A6, A9).

fields.name: AL
fields.description: Additive Latency: 00 = 0 (AL disabled), 01 = CL-1, 10 = CL-2, 11 = Reserved.

fields.name: D.I.C bit1
fields.description: Output Driver Impedance Control high-order bit. {A5,A1}: 00 = RZQ/6, 01 = RZQ/7, 10/11 = RZQ/TBD.

fields.name: Rtt_Nom bit1
fields.description: Middle bit of Rtt_Nom (combined with A2, A9).

fields.name: Write Leveling
fields.description: Write Leveling enable: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.

fields.name: Rtt_Nom bit2
fields.description: High-order bit of Rtt_Nom. {A9,A6,A2}: 000 = Rtt_Nom disabled, 001 = RZQ/4, 010 = RZQ/2, 011 = RZQ/6, 100 = RZQ/12, 101 = RZQ/8, 110/111 = Reserved.

fields.name: TDQS
fields.description: Termination Data Strobe enable (x8 only): 0 = Disabled (DM/TDQS pin acts as DM), 1 = Enabled (pin acts as TDQS output).

fields.name: Qoff
fields.description: Output Buffer Disable: 0 = Output buffer enabled, 1 = Output buffer disabled (DQ/DQS/DQS# disconnected; useful for IDD module power measurement).

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved for Future Use; must be programmed to 0.

registers.name: MR2
registers.long_name: Mode Register 2 — Partial Array Self-Refresh / CAS Write Latency / Auto Self-Refresh / Self-Refresh Temperature / Dynamic ODT

fields.name: PASR
fields.description: Partial Array Self-Refresh: 000 = Full Array, 001 = Half Array (BA[2:0]=000,001,010,011), 010 = Quarter Array (BA[2:0]=000,001), 011 = 1/8 Array (BA[2:0]=000), 100 = 3/4 Array, 101 = Half Array (BA[2:0]=100..111), 110 = Quarter Array (BA[2:0]=110,111), 111 = 1/8 Array (BA[2:0]=111). Optional feature.

fields.name: ASR
fields.description: Auto Self-Refresh: 0 = Manual SR Reference (SRT bit used), 1 = ASR enabled (DRAM tracks temperature). Optional feature.

fields.name: SRT
fields.description: Self-Refresh Temperature Range: 0 = Normal operating range (0–85 °C), 1 = Extended operating range (0–95 °C). Used when ASR=0.

fields.name: Rtt_WR
fields.description: Dynamic ODT during writes: 00 = Dynamic ODT off (write does not affect Rtt), 01 = RZQ/4 (60 Ω), 10 = RZQ/2 (120 Ω), 11 = Reserved.

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved for Future Use; must be programmed to 0.

registers.name: MR3
registers.long_name: Mode Register 3 — Multi Purpose Register Enable

fields.name: MPR-Loc
fields.description: Multi Purpose Register location: 00 = Predefined Pattern (for system calibration), 01/10/11 = RFU.

fields.name: MPR
fields.description: MPR Operation: 0 = Normal operation (reads come from DRAM array; A[1:0] ignored), 1 = Enable MPR mode (subsequent RD/RDA commands return predefined pattern).

fields.name: RFU
fields.description: Reserved for Future Use; must be programmed to 0.

registers.name: MPR
registers.long_name: Multi-Purpose Register (indirect, accessed via MR3 A2=1)
registers.access: Read via RD/RDA commands while MPR enabled (MR3 A2=1).
registers.description: Predefined data pattern for system-level read timing calibration. Pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1] is driven on DQ[0] of every byte lane during a BL8 read; DQ[7:1] either drive the same pattern as DQ[0] or drive 0. Addressing: BA[2:0] = don't care, A[1:0] = 00, A2 = 0 (burst order 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7) or A2 = 1 (burst order 4,5,6,7 for BC4), A12/BC# = 1 for BL8, other address bits = don't care. DLL must be locked prior to MPR reads.

fields.name: Predefined Pattern
fields.description: Fixed pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1] (LSB→MSB) used for system-level read timing calibration. Pattern is non-programmable in MR3 A[1:0]=00.
